posts.lead: A goalie who sits doesn't score. Three habits that save your week:
bullets: Check who is in net before lock
Teams often rest a goalie on the second night
Know which goalie you'd swap in

caption.instagram:
🏒 Fantasy hockey tip: check your goalies first.

1️⃣ Confirm who's starting before lock
2️⃣ Watch back-to-backs, when teams often rest a goalie
3️⃣ Keep a backup ready to swap in

Who's your goalie this year? 👇
